estados.title: Explore Mexico by state
estados.description: Mexico is divided into 32 states, each with its own identity, cuisine, traditions and landscapes. From the Caribbean beaches of Quintana Roo to the deserts of Chihuahua, through the mountains of Oaxaca and the jungles of Chiapas, each state offers unique experiences. Choose a state to discover its Pueblos Mágicos, museums, archaeological zones and the best road trip routes.

estadoDetail.discoverBestRoutes: Discover the best road trip routes that pass through {state}.

pueblosMagicos.title: Pueblos Mágicos of Mexico
pueblosMagicos.description: Pueblos Mágicos are towns recognized by Mexico's Ministry of Tourism for preserving exceptional cultural, historical or natural heritage. Since 2001, the program has distinguished over 130 towns across the country, each with its own magic: living traditions, colonial architecture, unique cuisine and unforgettable landscapes. Explore the full list and find your next destination.
pueblosMagicos.discoverBestMuseums: Discover the best museums in Mexico

museos.title: Museums in Mexico
museos.description: Mexico has over 1,200 museums spanning pre-Hispanic and colonial art to contemporary art, science, natural history and popular culture. Mexico City alone has more than 150, more than any other city in Latin America. Explore our guide with hours, prices and recommendations for each museum.

zonasArqueologicas.title: Archaeological zones of Mexico
zonasArqueologicas.description: Mexico has over 200 archaeological zones open to the public, testimony to the great civilizations that flourished before the arrival of the Spanish: Aztecs, Maya, Zapotecs, Mixtecs, Totonacs and many more. From the pyramids of Teotihuacan to the Maya cities in the jungle, explore our complete guide with hours, prices and recommendations.

rutas.title: Routes across Mexico
rutas.description: Mexico is best explored by road. Discover our curated routes with must-see stops, distances, driving times, estimated costs and tips for each stretch. From the Ruta Maya through Yucatan to the Copper Canyon on the Chepe, we have the perfect road trip for you.

guias.title: Travel guides for Mexico
guias.description: Editorial articles with everything you need to know for your next trip to Mexico. From Pueblos Mágicos guides and archaeological zone guides to practical road trip tips, regional cuisine and seasonal recommendations.

precios.title: Plans and pricing
precios.description: Choose the plan that best fits your trips across Mexico. Start for free and upgrade when you need to.
precios.faqChangePlan: Can I change my plan at any time?
precios.faqChangePlanAnswer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, the cost will be prorated. When downgrading, the change will take effect at the end of the current period.
precios.faqPaymentMethods: What payment methods do you accept?
precios.faqPaymentMethodsAnswer: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through Stripe. All payments are in Mexican pesos (MXN).
precios.faqCancel: Can I cancel at any time?
precios.faqCancelAnswer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You will continue to have access to your current plan until the paid period ends.
precios.faqDowngrade: What happens to my trips if I downgrade?
precios.faqDowngradeAnswer: Your saved trips are not deleted, but you won't be able to create new trips until you are within the limits of your current plan.
precios.faqDiscounts: Do you offer discounts for teams or students?
precios.faqDiscountsAnswer: Contact us at soporte@rutasenmx.com to ask about special discounts for groups, students or educational institutions.

acercaDe.title: About Rutas en MX
acercaDe.description: We are a platform dedicated to making road trip planning in Mexico easier. We believe the best adventures start with a good route and the right information to enjoy every kilometer of the journey.
acercaDe.missionP1: At Rutas en MX we want every traveler, whether local or foreign, to be able to discover the cultural, historical and natural richness of Mexico through well-planned road trips. Our mission is to democratize access to quality tourism information by integrating official Mexican government data with modern planning tools.
acercaDe.missionP2: Mexico has over 130,000 kilometers of paved roads, 177 Pueblos Mágicos, more than 1,300 museums and hundreds of archaeological zones. However, much of this information is scattered across multiple sources. We gather, verify and present it in a useful way so you can plan your next trip with confidence.
acercaDe.roadRoutesDesc: We design and curate thematic routes connecting Mexico's most interesting destinations, with information on distances, times, tolls and estimated costs.
acercaDe.destinationDirectoryDesc: We maintain an up-to-date catalog of Pueblos Mágicos, museums, archaeological zones and other points of interest in each state.
acercaDe.travelGuidesDesc: We publish detailed guides with practical recommendations, best times to visit, what to bring and how to make the most of each destination.
acercaDe.tripPlannerDesc: Our planning tool lets you create personalized itineraries, calculate costs and discover interesting stops along your way.
acercaDe.teamP1: Rutas en MX was born from the passion of a group of Mexicans for their country and for road trips. Our team combines experience in technology, tourism and design to create a platform that reflects the diversity and beauty of Mexico.
acercaDe.teamP2: We work with open data from the Mexican government, including information from the Ministry of Tourism (SECTUR), the National Institute of Anthropology and History (INAH) and the Cultural Information System (SIC), to ensure the information we present is accurate and reliable.
acercaDe.valueAccuracyDesc: We verify every piece of data with official sources. If you find an error, you can report it and we will correct it.
acercaDe.valueAccessibilityDesc: We believe tourism information should be free and accessible to everyone. Our basic content will always be free.
acercaDe.valueTransparencyDesc: We document our sources, methodology and editorial policy so you know how we obtain and verify information.
acercaDe.valueResponsibleTourismDesc: We promote trips that respect local communities, cultural heritage and Mexico's environment.
acercaDe.loveToHear: We love hearing from our community of travelers.
